## Incident Overview

tests/docs/test-reviewer-blindspot-annotations.sh adds `test_deep_tier_has_negative_scope_constraint` and `test_preoutput_checklist_in_generated_agent` which grep generated agent markdown. Generated content is doubly brittle (template change + assertion change required for legitimate edit).

## Source

CI llm-review iteration 8 finding [15] on PR #37 (job 74100719710). Classified IMPORTANT by reviewer; analysis classified MINOR — generation contract enforcement.

## Suggested Fix

Either assert on the template source rather than the generated artifact, or document the pairing constraint.
